articles.title: Weir would swap Ballon d'Or nominations for World Cup
articles.summary: Caroline Weir reflects on her Ballon d'Or nomination while eyeing a World Cup spot with Scotland.

articles.title: Cunningham-South out of three-day England training squad due to injury
articles.summary: England will be without Chandler Cunningham-South and Benhard Janse van Rensburg for their upcoming three-day training camp ahead of the Autumn Nations Series due to injury.
